title: wt repo-local configuration (.wtrc)
description: Schema for a .wtrc at the root of a repository's main worktree. Values override the global config and its repos entry. See https://github.com/AirConditionedSoftware/wt#repo-local-config-wtrc.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation; ignored by wt.

name.description: What {repo} expands to for this repo; overrides a matching global repos entry's name. Default: the directory basename of the main worktree.

worktree_dir.description: Path template for new worktrees. {repo} and {branch} are substituted; a leading ~ expands to the home directory. Default: ~/worktrees/{repo}/{branch}.

default_base.description: Ref that brand-new branches start from. Empty means the current HEAD.

branch_prefix.description: Prefix for branch names wt add creates, joined with prefix_separator: "peter" -> peter/fix-login. Existing branches are used as-is.

prefix_separator.description: What joins branch_prefix to the branch name. Default: "/".

copy_hooks.description: Copy the repo's git hooks into each new worktree. Only relevant when core.hooksPath points inside the worktree; plain .git/hooks is already shared.

copy_files.description: Untracked files to copy into each new worktree, as paths or globs relative to the main worktree (e.g. ".env*"). A repo-level list replaces the global one; [] disables.

vscode_open.description: Open each new worktree in VS Code after creation (needs the code CLI). Also gates the wt open command.

vscode_workspace_file.description: Write a .code-workspace file next to each new worktree.

vscode_workspace_prefix.description: Prefix for the workspace file's name: <prefix><branch>.code-workspace.

vscode_window_title.description: window.title written verbatim into the workspace file; VS Code title variables like ${activeEditorShort} pass through. Default: the repo name.

workspace_paths.description: Extra folders added to generated .code-workspace files after the worktree itself. A repo-level list replaces the global one.

name.description: Display name of the folder in VS Code.

path.description: Folder location; a leading ~ expands to the home directory.

full_paths.description: Show absolute paths in human-facing output instead of abbreviating the home directory to ~.

post_create.description: Shell commands run inside each newly created worktree, in order via sh -c. Commands from a repo's .wtrc need one-time approval on wt add. Worktree metadata is passed as WT_* environment variables.
